errors.text_span: 单位为“难度值”，轴标签为“难度值”
errors.evidence: The x-axis in the chart has numerical ticks but no axis label or specified unit. The description hallucinates that the unit and the label are both '难度值' (Difficulty Value).

errors.text_span: 这些条目按难度值从低到高排序，即柱状图从上至下长度递增
errors.evidence: The chart items are sorted by difficulty value in descending order, from the highest value (11.751...) at the top to the lowest value (11.331...) at the bottom. Therefore, the bar lengths decrease from top to bottom, not increase.

errors.text_span: 且按难度值升序排列，即从上至下难度值递增
errors.evidence: This is a repetition of the previous error. The data is sorted in descending order (high to low), not ascending order (low to high).
